snippet.title: ChickOut! Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Chickout is a co-op puzzle platformer for 2-6 players, playable locally or online! Team up as cute chicks, overcome obstacles, and enjoy chaotic fun together. Dont forget add wishlist!
